verdict.rationale: Docs show explicit support for ingesting raw documents, files, URLs, JSON/content, and business data via connectors (Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, GitHub) with multi-modal extraction (PDFs, images, video, code), not just chat transcripts — supported by GitHub repo details and code samples for content ingestion beyond conversations. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of ingesting structured JSON/business data specifically beyond docs/connectors, and one community report of size limits on link ingestion.
